projects.title: Over-center cam latch
projects.summary: A two-cam over-center latch sized from pressure-angle, torque, and bearing side-load analysis.
projects.body:
## The problem

Draft: describe what the latch needs to hold, why an over-center design, and the constraints you were working inside.

## Approach

- Compared cycloidal and linear motion laws for the cam rise to keep pressure angle and peak torque down.
- Checked needle bearing side loads on the follower.
- Split the load across two cams and checked how evenly they share it.

## Validation

Planned: SolidWorks Motion study for the force profile through the stroke, then FEA on the cam plate and pivot.

projects.title: Network-wide ad blocking with Pi-hole
projects.summary: A Raspberry Pi 3 running Pi-hole as the DNS server for the whole home network.
projects.body:
## Setup

- Raspberry Pi 3 on wired Ethernet, Wi-Fi disabled.
- Upstream DNS: Quad9 (filtered, DNSSEC).
- Blocklists: StevenBlack and OISD Big, about 350k domains, plus two regex filters.

## Router quirks
